title: The Whisper
narration: Fifteen billion miles away, a faint signal. Voyager 1, humanity's farthest reach, still speaks.
visual_goal: Deep space, a tiny spacecraft silhouette against stars, a radio wave pulse

title: Leaving Home
narration: Launched in 1977, it flew past Jupiter and Saturn. Then, in 2012, it crossed into interstellar space.
visual_goal: Launch footage, Jupiter and Saturn flybys, then a boundary crossing animation

title: The Golden Record
narration: On board, a Golden Record. Sounds and images chosen by Carl Sagan. A message for anyone out there.
visual_goal: Close-up of the Golden Record, its cover, and symbolic graphics

title: Fading Power
narration: Its signal takes 22.5 hours to reach us. Power is fading—down to 238 watts. But it still transmits.
visual_goal: Animation of signal travel time, power gauge dropping, Deep Space Network antennas

title: The Silent Emissary
narration: By 2030, its instruments will go quiet. But Voyager will keep sailing—toward Ophiuchus. Forever our first step.
visual_goal: Constellation Ophiuchus, a spacecraft drifting away, fading into stars
